title: Viking Warriors and Candlelit Lady
description: Three horned Viking warriors in detailed armor stand dynamically on the left, one raising a sword, another a spear, and the third kneeling, all rendered in white line art against a black background with astrological symbols and golden rings. On the right, a woman in an elegant off-shoulder gown sits on a blue velvet couch holding a lit candle, gazing toward a large arched window showing a cracked icy landscape at sunset.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene on black background, three fierce Viking warriors with horned helmets and ornate armor dynamically posed on the left, one with sword raised, one with spear, one kneeling, all in intricate white line art with gold accents and floating astrological symbols, on the right a beautiful woman in flowing off-shoulder grey gown sitting on a luxurious blue velvet couch holding a glowing candle, large arched window behind her revealing a frozen cracked ice landscape with sunset, dramatic chalk drawing style with bokeh lights
